Caṅgadāsa
or Cāṅgadāsa. a Kāyastha; follower of Buddha. (See RASB. VI. Intro. p. lxxvff.).
--Sambandhoddeśa or Caṅgavṛtti. gr. Cāndra school. metrical Kārikās with prose C. preserved in Tibetan an. ascribed to Cākādāsa (JASB. iii. 1907, p. 124).
C.. VIII. 101. IO. 5083. Oudh VI. 6.
Ref. to in a. ins. a. Pagan dated 1442 A. D. (J. Myth. Soc. XXII. p. 412). See Ind. Ant. XXV. p. 105.
See also Cāṅgu.

Caṅgadeva
father of Harideva (a. of Mayaṇaparājayacariu). See Jaina Sid. Bhās. XX. ii. p. 32.

Cāṅgadeva
astronomer a. Yādava Sim3ghaṇa's Court; 13th Cent. A. D. (Epi. Ind. I. p. 340); cousin of astronomer Anantadeva (NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 164b); an. grandson of the great Bhāskara.
See also S. B. Dikshit, Bhāratīya Jyotiṣa (Hindi edn.) p.. 343-45, (name given a. Caṅgadeva).

Caṅgavṛtti
or Sambandhopadeśa. gr. by Caṅgadāsa.
Alph. List Beng. Govt. p. 38 (with C.). BORI. 655 of 1884-86. 493 of 1886-92. Cordier III. p. 460. C.. VIII. 101. IO. 5083. L. 2857. Oudh VI. 6. (an. C.). Peters. III. p. 407 (no. 655). IV. p. 18 (no. 493). Sūcīpattra 90 (kārikā). Vaṅgīya Sup. 1901 (inc.).
Same a. Sambandhoddeśa (kārikā an. vṛtti).
See Ind. Ant. XXV. p. 105; also Cāṅguvṛttiº.
Pt.. Vizagapatam, 1896. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1892-1906. 129. [Page292-b]

Cāṅkaradaivajña
patronized by Pratāpasim3ha, descendant of Śivāji.
--Satkarmakalpadruma. dh. compiled in 1842 A. D. RASB. II. 1643.

Cāṅgadeva_Bhaṭṭa
son of Nāgapāśa (-nābha) Bhaṭṭa; father of Bhaṭṭa Govinda; grandfather of Bhaṭṭa Rāmeśvara; great grandfather of Bhaṭṭa Nārāyaṇa (a. of C. on Vṛttaratnākara; 1681 A. D. IO. 1094. Oxf. 198b).

Cāṅgu
or Caṅgadāsa. Bud. writer.
--Vaiyākaraṇajīvātu or Cāṅgusūtra, L. 2857. Vaṅgīya Sup. 1901 (inc.). (Cāṅguvyākaraṇa). C.. Caṅgadāsa. RASB. VI. 4414. 4415. 4417.

Cāṅguvyākaraṇa
by Cāṅgu. Vaṅgīya Sup. 1901 (inc.). See next.

Cāṅgusūtra
in 60 kārikās. by Caṅgadāsa or Cāṅgu. L. 2857. RASB. VI. 4414. 4415. 4417. Vaṅgīya Sup. 1901 (inc.). (Cāṅguvyākaraṇa).
--C. Caṅgu vṛtti or Vaiyākaraṇajīvātu; also called Sūtrānuvartinī; by a. himself. RASB. VI. 4414-17.
